title: 第一卷 第5章 隐秘的开机键-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》
content:
第(1/3)页

    手术室的无影灯亮得刺眼，将整间屋子照得惨白。

    “主任，患者虽然不是真的脑死亡，但对外界刺激没有任何肌肉反应。这麻药……用一半足够了吧？”

    助手医生站在手术台旁，看着台上安静躺着的上官程，眼中闪过一丝贪婪的精明。麻药昂贵，省下来的那些，都是他们自己的私房钱。

    “一半？”主刀医生掀了掀眼皮，目光比助手更加精明算计，“一个重度昏迷十天都没醒的人，用一滴也是资源浪费。”

    “可是一点不用……他中途不会疼醒吧？”

    “醒了又怎样？已经开膛破肚的鱼，还能翻起什么浪花？”主刀医生嗤笑一声，“到时候我随手给他心脏来那么几下，神仙来了也救不了！好了不废话了，赶紧开始，那位还在外面等着结果呢。”

    锋利的银色刀刃刺入上官程胸膛的皮肤，鲜红的血液顺流而下，在惨白的灯光下格外刺目。

    主刀医生手法熟练，正打算顺着切割线将面前的胸膛彻底剖开时，一只冰冷的手猛然扣住了他的手腕！

    力道大得惊人，像一把铁钳，纹丝不动。

    主刀医生愣了一瞬，下意识转头看去。恰与男人睁开的双目对上。

    那双桃花眼里没有刚苏醒的迷茫，没有虚弱，只有冰冷的、浓烈的、几乎要凝成实质的杀意。

    上官程上辈子就死在此人的手术刀下，脏器被切的七零八落，连伤口都懒得给他缝合。今生再遇，他绝不会轻易放过对方！

    重生后的他拥有了一副全新的身体——没有病痛，没有虚弱，每一寸肌肉都充满了力量。加之他在千次任务中积累了丰富的格斗经验，如今的他，犹如战神降世。

    只见他手猛然一拧，主刀医生那把握刀的手瞬间扭曲成诡异的形状。

    “啊——”伴随着惨叫声，沾着血的手术刀“哐当”一声掉落在地，发出刺耳的脆响。

    “求……你……”主刀医生骨头咯吱作响，疼得他冷汗直流。

    上官程没有给他求饶的机会。

    翻身坐起，一拳挥出。

    没有犹豫，没有留情。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The shadowless lights in the operating room were so bright that they illuminated the whole room pale.

"Director, although the patient is not really brain-dead, he does not have any muscle response to external stimulation. Isn't half of this anesthetic enough?"

The assistant doctor stood beside the operating table, looking at Shangguan Cheng lying quietly on the table, with a hint of greedy shrewdness in his eyes.Anesthetics are expensive, and whatever they save is their own private money.

"Half?" The surgeon in charge raised his eyelids, his eyes more shrewd and calculating than his assistant's, "For a person who has been in a severe coma for ten days and hasn't woken up, even one drop would be a waste of resources."

"But it's not necessary at all...he won't wake up in pain in the middle, right?"

"So what if he wakes up? What kind of waves can a fish that has been disembowelled make waves?" The surgeon in charge sneered, "When the time comes, I will just give him a few heartbeats, and even the gods will not be able to save him! Okay, let's stop talking nonsense and start quickly. The guy is still outside waiting for the results."

The sharp silver blade pierced the skin of Shangguan Cheng's chest, and the bright red blood flowed down, which was particularly dazzling under the pale light.

The surgeon was skilled in technique, and when he was about to completely cut open the chest in front of him along the cutting line, a cold hand suddenly grabbed his wrist!

The force is astonishingly strong, like a pair of iron pliers, unable to move a muscle.

The surgeon was stunned for a moment, then subconsciously turned his head to look.Just in time to meet the man's open eyes.

There was no confusion or weakness in those peach blossom eyes, just a cold, strong, almost solid murderous intention.

Shangguan Cheng died under this man's scalpel in his last life. His organs were cut to pieces and he didn't even bother to sew up his wounds.If they meet again in this life, he will never let him go easily!

After rebirth, he had a brand new body - no pain, no weakness, every inch of muscle was full of strength.In addition, he has accumulated rich fighting experience in thousands of missions, and now he is like the God of War coming to the world.

I saw his hand suddenly twisted, and the hand of the surgeon holding the knife instantly twisted into a strange shape.

“Ah——” Along with the scream, the bloody scalpel fell to the ground with a clang, making a harsh crisp sound.

"Please...you..." The surgeon's bones creaked, and the pain made him sweat.

Shangguan Cheng did not give him a chance to beg for mercy.

He turned over and sat up, punching out.

No hesitation, no mercy.
